---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: '[FEATREQ] Brief description of the feature'
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''

---

## Feature Summary
<!-- A brief, clear description of what you want to happen -->

## Problem Statement
<!-- Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
E.g., "I'm always frustrated when [...]" or "The game would be better if [...]" -->

## Proposed Solution
<!-- A detailed description of how you envision this feature working -->

## User Experience
<!-- Describe how users would interact with this feature -->

## Benefits
<!-- Why should this feature be implemented? Who would benefit? -->

## Alternatives Considered
<!-- Have you thought of alternative ways to achieve this? -->

## Mockups / Examples
<!-- Any sketches, designs, or examples from other applications that illustrate your idea -->

## Implementation Ideas
<!-- Optional: If you have technical knowledge, provide suggestions on how this might be implemented -->

## Scope
<!-- Is this a small enhancement or a major feature? Would it require significant changes? -->

## Additional Context
<!-- Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here -->

## Checklist
<!-- Please check these items before submitting -->
- [ ] I have searched for similar feature requests and confirmed this is not a duplicate
- [ ] I have provided sufficient detail to understand the feature request
- [ ] I have considered the value this brings to most users, not just my specific use case
